name: Vancouver Coastal Health North Shore Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteers help at Lions Gate Hospital, community health clinics, long-term care homes and community programs. Roles include the info desk and wayfinding, friendly visiting, clinic support and special events.
who_can_apply: The North Shore page says its volunteers are people over 16 years old. You need maturity, reliability and good communication skills.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer. Volunteers can get reference letters and recognition.
duration: 2 to 3 hours a week for at least 6 months
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply online any time.
how_to_apply: Fill in the North Shore online application. The process takes 4 to 8 weeks and includes a criminal record check run by VCH, then an interview, reference checks, orientation and training.
notes: North Shore Volunteer Resources: (604) 984-5929, nsvolunteer@vch.ca. VCH's Vancouver program (VGH, UBC Hospital, G.F. Strong) does not state a minimum age on its pages, so ask vanvolunteer@vch.ca before applying there.
